brief: Found by R10-SETPOINT-BOOST's demand analysis (tvofi 2026-10-19: the planner fills the whole day with heating; fixes must work on every install, without a heat meter). The plan books about 38 kWh/day electric for space while the metered October average is about 8.6 kWh/day for space plus hot water, roughly 8x over-booked. The learned UA implies far more loss than metered delivery supports; idle phantom draw explains only about 5%. Root-cause by replay on synthetic installs (never the owner's private export): UA learner bias, booked-vs-delivered heat, comfort weights. Then fix so planned demand matches delivered heat with no heat sensor. Controls: flat-price null, a synthetic install spread, mutation, and a DP reference for solver optimality (not run in SETPOINT-BOOST).
